method: Retrieved each bounded BrickLink part catalog page and recorded only entries in its Known Colors section. Counts are catalog occurrence counts shown there, not current seller inventory. LDraw names and RGB values come from the bundled official LDConfig.ldr.
limitations: Evidence establishes that BrickLink catalogs the part/color combination; it does not establish current seller stock, price, quantity, clutch compatibility, connection legality, structural stability, or buildability.
Source RGB is quantized to this finite solid-color palette and is not an exact photographic color reproduction.
Only listed lots were observed in the retrieved Known Colors sections. Missing combinations are unsupported and must not be inferred from LDraw geometry or palette membership.
Part aliases 3068b, 3069b, and 3070b use the corresponding BrickLink base design pages 3068, 3069, and 3070.
